# Spinach omelette

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Per serving** | 330 kcal · 26 g P · 3 g C · 24 g F |
| **Slot** | breakfast, dinner |
| **Prep** | quick-cook · 10 min · serves 1 |
| **Nutrition** | estimated |
| **Status** | active |

## Ingredients
- 3 eggs
- 80 g spinach
- 20 g cheddar
<!-- coach:end card spinach-omelette -->

## Method
1. Wilt the spinach in a hot pan.
2. Pour over the beaten eggs, add the cheese, fold.
